title: We Have a Deal: a research toolkit for bilateral negotiation
description:
An open arena for automated freight-rate negotiation, with the nine reference negotiation architectures (rule-based, search, optimization, imitation-learned and reinforcement-learned) and their trained weights, a toolkit for benchmarking your own agents locally, and everything the accompanying paper reports: raw tournament and LLM-study data, figures, analysis notebooks and experiment scripts.

Accompanying paper: Before AI Agents Negotiate for Us: A Competitive Tournament of Rule-Based, Search, Optimization, Learned, and Language-Model Negotiators Under Scarcity.
